order: Python Random outer_seed shuffles all117 product/supplement rows each outer pair, and independently shuffles old/candidate order per row. Each process reports seven complete repetitions. All seven process pairs must independently pass the declared median/CV gates. Core keeps the existing18 pairwise-process groups,32names/14default-unprepared pairs, seven repetitions and seven outer rounds.
framework_order: Original and current Google Benchmark1.9.5 enable random interleaving, internally seed std::random_device. No supported CLI seed; outer seed does not control that inner shuffle. Product is filtered to one row per process. Core retains isolated pair groups.
supplement_timer: steady_clock real_time ns, end-to-end unprepared public request copy, triangulate and owning result/request destruction within each interval. std::clock CPU field is diagnostic and is not the supplement gate metric. Same source compiled independently with each artifact's matching public headers/library; no private support.
cold: Before every measured public call, release_thread_caches outside interval on both sides. Fresh process and ready/go OS module/placement observation before any geometry. No verification or warmup in that process. This means cold library TLS/cache state, not hardware cache eviction. Sweep always kernel; CDT>=512 only lookup-eligible; twenty actual cold kernel-entry observations per artifact are prerequisite.
default: Fresh process, ready/go observation, one second public warmup then seven measured repetitions. Do not call verification in that process. Successful repeated CDT may use existing cache; point count alone does not prove a hit.
admission: Exactly required rows, >=7 complete unique raw repetition indexes, declared run and aggregate identities/units, error-free positive finite primary times, actual median and dimensionlessCV*100 matching raw samples; no raw-last or mean fallback. CPU/CV and wall/CV evaluated separately. No missing-row, legacy-invalid or noisy exemption.
module_observation: Prehash exact executable/runtime, bind producing command/run/PID to actual OS executable and all loaded Clipper paths/hashes, verify before/after. Original GB runs finish observation within source-proven one-second warmup; no MinTime/MinWarmUpTime/Iterations/MeasureProcessCPUTime overrides. Supplement ready/go completes all hashes before timing. Fail closed on late/missing/foreign observation.

isolation: No competing build/test/hash/profile or other measured work on shared cores/cache/memory during formal processes. Observer has disjoint physical core including SMT siblings; heavy hashing/profiling ends before formal intervals. No global governor/boost/policy changes. Platform actor records co-tenancy and actual power state before run.
retention: Fresh evidence root only. Keep every raw process JSON/log, order, exit, observation, error, missing/duplicate/noisy record and failed candidate. No exclusions by timing outcome; no lucky search. Diagnose noise outside formal runs; a repeat requires recorded objective environment correction and a new complete matrix, preserves prior failure and never re-signs old results.
uncertainty: Seven paired process median ratios per row; report median paired ratio and deterministic10000-resample descriptive bootstrap95% interval. Never replace or waive any per-pair threshold/CV gate; no claim that seven pairs guarantee future behavior.
